stories.title: Shot of the Day
stories.detail: Hole in one on the 2nd - the shot everyone's talking about

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Visitor from Tumut GC sitting 2nd - raiding the local silverware

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Jaden Newbigging (Wagga City GC) - welcome to WWCC. We hope you enjoy the course and the hospitality.

stories.title: What On Earth Happened
stories.detail: +4 on hole 2 - the scorecard needs a moment to recover from that

stories.title: Four and Forgotten
stories.detail: Quadruple bogey on hole 2 - the committee has been informed and they are also confused

stories.title: A Very Thorough Hole
stories.detail: +5 on hole 3 - a comprehensive, detailed, expensive visit to that part of the course

stories.title: Technical Difficulties
stories.detail: 3 blow-ups on holes 1, 2 & 3 - please stand by

stories.title: Slow Starter
stories.detail: Over par from the first 3 on holes 1, 2 & 3

stories.title: Caught at the Post
stories.detail: Led most of the day, run down to 52nd at the death

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Brenton Kitson down to 31st from 1st - the run home turned into a run away

stories.title: Wooden Spoon Watch
stories.detail: Jenny Hart last today - Essendon finished 2 and 21, one bad day is nothing
